title: Products of two elements of Granville's random model in residue classes
summary: Erdős, Odlyzko and Sárközy conjectured that every reduced residue class modulo $q$ contains a product of two primes not exceeding $q$; their conjecture remains open even under the GRH. We prove that its analogue holds, unconditionally and in the wider range $q^Θ$ for any fixed $Θ> 3/4$, in Granville's random model of the primes. Almost surely, every reduced class modulo every sufficiently large modulus is representable, and the number of representations is asymptotic to its expected order.
